findings.title: Loss of precision when converting rounded cents to euros
findings.body: `toCents` converts a whole-cents amount back to euros, so `toCents(rounded)` on line 12 divides the rounded cents by 100 and returns a float. This loses the cent precision and can produce a result like 1.2349999999999999. Keep the amount in cents throughout the calculation and return an integer.

summary.problem: The new `depositCents` function converts a rounded cents value back to euros, losing cent precision.
summary.done_well: `depositCents` uses `totalCents` and `toCents` consistently with the rest of the file.
